description: The box key (5.1) from an identity seed: HKDF-SHA256 with the 32-byte Ed25519 seed as key material, an empty salt and info "tubes-fed v1 box", 32 bytes, clamped as RFC 7748 says (byte 0 &= 248, byte 31 &= 127, byte 31 |= 64), is the X25519 private key; box is its public key, base64url (43 characters).
